name: AIDC pair-side accumulated burn
summary: AIDCToken lets an ordinary router transfer burn the accumulated sell-side amount directly out of the AIDC/WBNB pair and then sync it, so repeated fresh-helper sells deflated the pair's AIDC reserve and let the attacker buy the pool out.
